content.short: Neighbourhoods Network provides tools to create and organize online communities within a new social framework.
content.description: Neighbourhoods Network is a protocol designed to lay the groundwork for a new social networking ecosystem. Built on the Holochain framework, it lets users shape digital spaces to reflect their cultures and activities, rather than a one-size-fits-all feed. Past actions and points are stored on your profile and can be used in other Holochain apps. The project aims to make social networking more transparent and beneficial for users, and to address questions about visibility, feed ordering, and collective harms online.
